source.selection: AWP hitchance 70 selected from 70-85, minimum damage 100. SCAR hitchance 60 selected from 55-65, minimum damage 35 selected from 30-38. Autoscope enabled and aim FOV 180 for both.

assumption: User requested these public reference values. Equivalent runtime behavior across Neverlose and Solace has not been verified. AWP minimum damage 100 filters lower-damage shots; this is not a fix for airborne or wallbang firing. Other settings are inherited unchanged from hvh_awp_tuned.
